get.description: Retrieve the history of score values for a specific object type and ID in the lead scoring framework. This endpoint allows you to track changes over time, up to the last 90 days, which can be useful for analyzing trends and understanding how scores have evolved.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource, used for pagination. This token is returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object for which the score history is being retrieved, specified as an integer.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The type of the object for which the score history is being retrieved, specified as a string.

parameters.name: outputProperty
parameters.description: The specific property of the score output to be included in the response, specified as a string.

get.description: Retrieve a list of lead scores from your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to paginate through scores using the 'limit' and 'after' query parameters. It is useful for accessing and managing lead scoring data in a structured manner. It is eventually consistent and may take a few seconds for new scores to show up.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 10.

post.description: Create a new lead scoring configuration in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define scoring rules and configurations for different object types, helping you to evaluate and prioritize leads effectively. The request body must include details such as object type ID, name, allowed group types, group configurations, and maximum score per category.

get.description: Retrieve the configuration of a specific lead score in your HubSpot account using the unique score ID. This endpoint is useful for accessing detailed information about a particular lead scoring configuration, including its properties and settings. A score that has never been published can be retrieved.

parameters.name: scoreId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the lead score to retrieve. It is required to specify which score's configuration you want to access.

delete.description: Delete a specific lead scoring configuration in your HubSpot account. This operation permanently removes the scoring configuration identified by the scoreId from the system, which can be useful for managing and cleaning up outdated or unnecessary scoring setups.

parameters.name: scoreId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the lead scoring configuration to delete.

post.description: Clone an existing lead scoring configuration identified by the scoreId. This operation creates a duplicate of the specified score configuration, allowing you to modify and use it independently from the original. It is useful for testing variations or creating similar scoring models without starting from scratch.

parameters.name: scoreId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the score configuration to clone.

post.description: Deactivate a specific lead scoring configuration in your HubSpot account. This endpoint is useful for temporarily disabling a scoring model without deleting it, allowing you to reactivate it later if needed.

parameters.name: scoreId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the score configuration to deactivate.

get.description: Retrieve the draft configuration of a specific lead scoring model using its score ID. This endpoint is useful for accessing the current draft state of a scoring model, allowing you to review or modify it before finalizing.

parameters.name: scoreId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the lead scoring model whose draft configuration is to be retrieved.

put.description: Update the draft configuration for a specific lead score in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to replace the current draft of a lead score configuration identified by the scoreId. Use this endpoint to make changes to the scoring criteria before publishing the final version. Rule and group IDs may differ between the live and draft configurations. Outputs are merged by ID and will remain the same.

parameters.name: scoreId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the lead score draft to update.

post.description: Publish a draft lead scoring configuration for a specific score identified by scoreId. This endpoint finalizes the draft configuration, making it active and applicable to the associated scoring processes.

parameters.name: scoreId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the lead score configuration to publish.

post.description: Reset the draft state of a specific lead scoring configuration in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful when you want to discard changes made to a draft and revert to the last published state. It ensures that any unsaved modifications are cleared, providing a clean slate for further edits.

parameters.name: scoreId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the lead scoring configuration draft to reset.

results.description: An array of public score fragments. Each item in the array is a PublicScoreFragment object.
An array of PublicScoreHistoryEntry objects, each representing a historical entry of score changes for an object.
